what_it_does: This system manages batteries in electric vehicles and energy storage by monitoring and balancing each cell individually using contactless (wireless) communication. Traditional wired approaches are cumbersome when a battery pack has 216 individual cells—imagine running 216 wires from each cell to a central controller. This system places a tiny chip on each cell that measures its voltage, stores data, and adjusts charge flow; these chips talk to a central hub wirelessly using near-field communication (NFC, the same technology in contactless credit cards). The architecture automatically forms a robust network, recovering if some communication channels fail.
